verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly support running evals on every pull request and integrating experiments into CI/CD. A terminal-native `bt` CLI can run evals, query logs and sync data, and a programmatic API plus code-defined `Eval()` SDK calls let it run without the UI. Missing for 10: documented CI specifics such as non-interactive/API-key authentication or a ready-made CI action, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless CI runs.
